title: Morning Bid: Outer SpaceX
summary: August 5 (Reuters) - What matters in U. and global markets today , Editor-at-Large, Finance and Markets For all the doubts and handwringing, the S&P; 500 and Dow Jones are back at record highs after surging on Tuesday amid falling oil prices and the bumper earnings season.
summary_zh: 8 月 5 日（路透社）——《金融与市场》特约编辑，当今美国和全球市场最重要的是什么？ 500 指数和道琼斯指数在周二因油价下跌和财报季丰收而飙升后又回到历史高位。

title: Wall Street warms to healthcare stocks as tech trade faces turbulence
title_zh: 由于科技贸易面临动荡，华尔街对医疗保健股青睐有加
summary: August 5 (Reuters) - Investors are pouring money into U. healthcare stocks, betting that improving earnings, rising dealmaking and attractive valuations will extend the sector's rebound after years of underperformance.
summary_zh: 8 月 5 日（路透社）——投资者正在向美国医疗保健股注入资金，押注盈利改善、交易增加和有吸引力的估值将延续该行业在多年表现不佳后的反弹。

title: Kenya's stock exchange plans East Africa's first AI-focused ETF
title_zh: 肯尼亚证券交易所计划推出东非首个以人工智能为重点的 ETF
summary: Kenya's Nairobi Securities Exchange is creating East Africa's first AI stocks-focused exchange-traded fund, which it plans to offer to investors before year-end, its CEO said.
summary_zh: 肯尼亚内罗毕证券交易所首席执行官表示，该交易所正在创建东非首个专注于人工智能股票的交易所交易基金，计划在年底前向投资者发售。

title: AI CapEx fears: Is big tech overspending?
title_zh: 人工智能资本支出担忧：大型科技公司是否超支？
summary: Host Kenny Polcari joins Man Group Chief Market Strategist Kristina Hooper and Legato Financial CIO Ryan Kelly to debate the risks of massive AI CapEx spending and how a hawkish Federal Reserve could impact markets ahead of the midterms.
summary_zh: 主持人 Kenny Polcari 与英仕曼集团首席市场策略师 Kristina Hooper 和 Legato Financial 首席信息官 Ryan Kelly 一起讨论大规模人工智能资本支出的风险，以及鹰派的美联储将如何在中期选举前影响市场。

title: Tech Melt-Up Drives $3.5 Trillion Nasdaq 100 Gain in Four Days
title_zh: 科技股熔涨带动纳斯达克 100 指数在四天内上涨 3.5 万亿美元

summary_zh: （彭博社）——科技股的戏剧性转变推动纳斯达克 100 指数市值在短短四天内增长了 3.5 万亿美元，强劲的盈利让投资者对人工智能前景更加乐观。彭博社的大多数报道特朗普称伊朗塔尔...

title: US Ban on Chinese Optical Parts Hurts Hyperscalers, Report Says
title_zh: 报告称，美国对中国光学零件的禁令损害了超大规模企业
summary: (Bloomberg) -- A potential ban on the import of Chinese optical transceiver modules into the US would inflict collateral damage on US hyperscalers, exacerbating a supply bottleneck that no American firm can ease, research firm Counterpoint warned on Wednesday.Most Read from Bl...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——研究公司 Counterpoint 周三警告称，美国可能禁止进口中国光收发器模块，这将对美国超大规模企业造成附带损害，从而加剧美国公司无法缓解的供应瓶颈。

title: AI demand pushes Foxconn's monthly revenue to record in July
title_zh: AI需求推动富士康7月月营收创历史新高
summary: Monthly revenue at Taiwanese contract electronics manufacturer Foxconn hit a record ‌in July, surpassing T$900 billion ($27.93 billion) for ‌the first time as strong demand for AI products boosted sales, ​the company said on Wednesday.
summary_zh: 台湾代工电子制造商富士康周三表示，由于对人工智能产品的强劲需求推动了销售，该公司 7 月份的月收入创下历史新高，首次超过 9000 亿新台币（合 279.3 亿美元）。

title: SpaceX teams up with Nvidia: Musk says Vera Rubin is 'the best AI computer'
title_zh: SpaceX 与 Nvidia 合作：马斯克称 Vera Rubin 是“最好的 AI 计算机”
summary: SpaceX (SPCX) CEO Elon Musk is teaming up exclusively with AI leader Nvidia (NVDA) for its AI infrastructure.
summary_zh: SpaceX (SPCX) 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 正在与人工智能领导者 Nvidia (NVDA) 独家合作开发人工智能基础设施。
